verdict: Re-check of the 2026-11-19 audit's eight defects at main d31154bc8: PR #17639 closed the three it marked (the $400 SE threshold is now pinned and its mutant caught, the page's 'Not modelled' paragraph is accurate, Form 8959 uses integer arithmetic and gives 277.88), and the committed wheel is gone. The README learning-curve table was still stale, as it has been since 2026-11-07, and the page and llms.txt quoted the same stale months 4-12 counts (1,300 of 2,164 against the benchmark's 1,296 of 2,161), because page.test.mjs checked the page against the README and not against the benchmark. Three lows persist (two-row ambiguous dates, asOf-less payment plan, groceries to Meals) and one is partly fixed (probe clutter). New tax checks were all right: Schedule SE at exactly $400 and with wages, 2026 HoH and 2025 single brackets, Form 8959 at two profits, MACRS 3-year. 2905 tests pass; both seeded bugs were caught. Scores before this PR's fix: claims 2, everything else 3, so it still misses the bar on claims. PR #20092 generates the README table from the benchmark and adds benchmark-readme.test.mjs, which compares the README, page and llms.txt with a fresh run, so the next re-audit can raise claims.
